memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Hypothyroidism: Status: stable on levothyroxine 50 mcg OD. Plan: Continue same dose, check TSH in 3 months.
- Asthma: Status: well‑controlled, using budesonide/formoterol 200/6 µg BD and salbutamol SOS. Plan: Continue current inhalers, monitor symptoms.
- Epilepsy: Status: seizure‑free on levetiracetam 500 mg BD and lamotrigine 50 mg BD. Plan: Continue meds, check EEG and electrolytes annually.
- Weight: 78 kg, Waist: 92 cm (above male cut‑off 90 cm). Diet advice: Breakfast – whole‑grain toast with egg white and vegetables; Lunch – brown rice, dal, mixed veg salad; Dinner – grilled fish, steamed broccoli, small portion rice.
- Due: Next HbA1c not required (no glucose‑lowering therapy).
